runtime.servletStack: Spring MVC on embedded Tomcat (jakarta.servlet), Spring Security JWT resource server, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Liquibase
runtime.database: PostgreSQL 18.3 (upstream prod profile database; dev profile H2 not used)

resetProcedure: Every run removes and recreates the private network, Postgres container (data on tmpfs) and app container; Liquibase (context prod) recreates the schema and upstream seeds only the built-in admin/user accounts. No faker data.
configAdaptations: Maven `prod` profile with the Angular client build skipped (-Dskip.installnodenpm -Dskip.npm): the campaign exercises the REST/JWT backend only; no webapp assets are served
build skips tests, checkstyle, spotless, modernizer and git-commit-id plugin; no source changes
Spring `prod` profile with datasource and JWT secret supplied via environment (campaign-synthetic values only; the JWT secret is NOT the upstream .yo-rc secret)
Postgres data directory on tmpfs and fsync=off (disposable data)

auth.syntheticAccounts: upstream-seeded admin and user (documented JHipster defaults); passwords redacted from recorded request bodies

seams: 12 parallel authenticate+getAccount as admin/user; recordings must not cross-associate principals

notApplicable.outbound: No outbound HTTP in the sample app; mail health is disabled upstream
